description: Organism developing under varying provisioning. Question is whether its own sensing apparatus gets validated against outcomes, and what reads out when it does not. Marker, not a claim.
boundary: organism periphery; environment outside it. Consequence delivery crosses this line.
provisioned: outcome delivery decoupled from the organism's own act
threat consequence absorbed before reaching the organism
open_questions: domain match between calibrating environment and test items
whether trust in own sensing is a measurement or a belief

falsifiers.statement: response magnitude per perturbation size is flat across the provisioning gradient
relearn time constant after a regime shift does not rise with provisioning
detection threshold does not rise with baseline staleness
practice rate predicts detection latency with baseline freshness controlled out
discrimination gradient across severities is flat in the calibrated group
